transcript.source: Library of Congress, Theodore Roosevelt Papers, Series 5, reel 424, frames 0455
diplomatic: The assigned page (424:0455, right half, folio 22) shows "Remarks of President Roosevelt at Columbia,S.C.,April 10,1902." (struck through with a hand-drawn line) and "Remarks of President Roosevelt at Chester, S.C., April 10,1902.", not Branchville. The Branchville remarks ("Remarks of President Roosevelt at Branchville, S.C., April 10,1902.") are on the left half of the same frame, 424:0455, folio 21, below the Summerville remarks. Not transcribed; job page reference should be corrected to half a.
